_interpretation: BAR_FORMING IGNORES OFFSET - same defect class as the other four candle-categoricals. The control is valid: close moved between the sections on all 3 coins, so offset was honoured in the same render. The offset-8 bar on a 1h anchor is by construction CLOSED - the render even prints its settled close beside the flag - yet bar answers 'forming', which is the offset-0 answer. The 2026-08-26 record's _honesty note allowed that 'ignores offset' might arguably be correct for this flag; the plan pre-committed the resolution: a question about a closed past bar should answer 'closed', so an unchanging 'forming' is the same silent-wrong-answer class. scope.untested is now empty; the existing OFFSET_NOT_HONOURED warning already covers BAR_FORMING (candle + vocab), so no validator change. Also worth keeping: budgetUsage.columnLookback read 32/32 for a 2-column-per-section report whose only offset is 8 - the 24-bar floor plus offset 8, exactly the lookback_floor.json arithmetic, independently confirmed in passing.
closes: offset_ignored.json scope.untested, the last untested entry of BG-13
